about: [O6b critic] the door lying (&ten=parts), straight into it: stand 1.8 m south of it facing north, look down at it, W held 1.6 s with no steering; where am I each quarter second?

steps.walk: (() => { const d = G.stage.smash.out.find(i=>i.part && i.kind==='cardoor'); return [[d.body.p.x, d.body.p.z + 4.5], [d.body.p.x, d.body.p.z + 1.9]]; })()

steps.eval: (() => { const d = G.stage.smash.out.find(i=>i.part && i.kind==='cardoor'); return JSON.stringify({me:[N.controller.pos.x,N.controller.pos.z].map(v=>+v.toFixed(2)), door:[d.body.p.x,d.body.p.y,d.body.p.z].map(v=>+v.toFixed(2)), q:[d.Q.x,d.Q.y,d.Q.z,d.Q.w].map(v=>+v.toFixed(2)), yaw:+N.controller.yaw.toFixed(2)}); })()
